## ESP32 Wireless Defense Lab v1.0.1

Final defensive maintenance release after the full P3 cleanup and verification pass.

### Highlights

- passive receive-only deauthentication/disassociation observation,
- per-source and BSSID burst detection with configurable threshold and cooldown,
- safer alert queuing outside the Wi-Fi callback,
- nearby 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi inventory,
- RSSI, channel, source, destination and reason-code alert context,
- channel event analytics,
- responsive local dashboard,
- mandatory first-boot credential replacement,
- HTTP Digest administrator authentication,
- per-boot CSRF protection,
- AES-256-GCM protected management credentials,
- fail-safe credential recovery,
- persistent event logs,
- optional SSD1306 OLED status,
- watchdog support,
- pinned PlatformIO toolchain,
- automated host detector tests,
- defensive-only source guard in CI,
- 90 percent flash-budget guard,
- browser installer and combined first-install firmware.

### Defensive-only scope

The maintained main branch does not include deauthentication transmission, Evil Twin or AP impersonation, password collection, handshake or PMKID harvesting, beacon or BLE flooding, or HID injection.

### Validation

GitHub Actions verifies detector logic, source-policy checks, ESP32 compilation, firmware packaging and flash budget. Physical RF sensitivity, OLED operation, false-positive behavior and long-duration stability still require validation on the actual ESP32 hardware.

### Files

- esp32-defense-lab-full.bin — combined first-install image for offset 0x0
- esp32-defense-lab-app.bin — application image
- SHA256SUMS.txt — SHA-256 checksums
